🚨gemini 4 Pro leaks

Google reportedly has its first pro checkpoint ready

gemini 4 pro is already being tested on arena, possibly disguised as “gemini-3.8-flash”

leaked benchmarks put it ahead of GPT 6 Astra and Fable 5.1

october is being floated for release but late september still possible

nothing confirmed yet, but the early outputs look ridiculous (dropping some results soon) 

could gemini 4 pro actually beat Astra?

post.originalText:
Gemini 4 Pro might actually give GPT 6 Astra some competition on 3D

this output from Arena caught my attention, so i gave Astra the exact same prompt:

- create a 3d model of wall-e in three.js.
- Astra took around 15 minutes to make the full thing 

Gemini’s tiny animations and interactions are really good but Astra held up surprisingly well.

this one is pretty close. 

be honest which output do you prefer?
